content.short: Fonbnk is a stablecoin settlement layer bridging mobile-first, cash-based economies to onchain payments.
content.description: Fonbnk connects mobile-first and cash-based economies to stablecoin payments, notably by letting users convert mobile airtime credit into digital dollars. That mechanism matters in markets where prepaid airtime is more widely held than a bank account, making conventional card-based onramps unusable for most people.
